reviews.h2: Pet parents trust us with their own
reviews.basedOn: Rated 4.3 out of 5, based on 175 Google reviews

items.author: Asmaa B.
items.text: The best veterinarian I have ever seen, very competent, he did exceptional work and saved my cat who was going to die. A thousand thanks to Dr Bassir, who is the best, really HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

items.author: Kenza B.
items.text: A very committed and kind doctor who met us in the middle of the night and saved our dog’s life. The staff are also very kind and affectionate with the animals. Highly recommended!

items.author: Mia M.
items.text: I have been bringing my dog (a malinois) for over 3 years and I am very satisfied. The doctor is very kind, attentive, helpful, and the prices are reasonable. Thank you so much for the quality of your work.

items.author: Rita I.
items.text: This has been my veterinary clinic for almost 9 years, and I am very, very happy with them for my babies. Impeccable, with so much humanity. The staff are wonderfully caring too.

items.author: Amal H.
items.text: I have been seeing Dr Bassir, my cats’ veterinarian, for more than 15 years, and I am very satisfied with his services. His expertise and skill with animals, especially cats, are remarkable!

items.author: Fatim-Zohra A.
items.text: A top clinic, very clean at any hour. Quality care and surgery. A veterinarian who listens to owners and their animals. A very competent, very kind, friendly team, always smiling.
